description:
[0.98a] ExchangeRefit v1.1.1 - Advanced Ship Layout Copier/Paster & Player Sharing

Author:

Anjasnare

Game Version:

Starsector 0.98a-RC8 (Utility Mod - Safe to add/remove mid-save)

Compatibility:

Fully integrated and synchronized with

Advanced Gunnery Control

&

Progressive S-Mods

Description

Tired of manually rebuilding your ships every time you buy a new hull? Annoyed by keyboard hotkey conflicts from older scripts?

ExchangeRefit adds a fully interactive, mouse-driven shipyard terminal directly inside any orbital station or planet dialogue menu =>

Press "x"

. It allows you to copy, save, and apply complete ship layouts (Weapons, Flux Vents, Capacitors, Hullmods, and S-Mods) seamlessly using your fleet cargo resources.

Since layouts are saved as standalone lightweight text files, you can easily send them to your friends to share your best builds!

Key Features

- Full Mouse UI Integration: Accessible natively from any market dock via conversation choices. No more blind keypresses while flying in space!

- 5 Archive Slots per Hull: Keep up to 5 customized loadouts for every single ship hull in the game.

- Real Cargo and Resource Management: Automatically unmounts old weapons back into your cargo (no lost items). It safely checks your inventory and consumes the required weapons or fighters from your fleet soute upon pasting (prevents cheating).

- Advanced Gunnery Control Sync: Automatically backs up and restores your custom Weapon AI priorities, targeting behaviors, and automated fire group settings on the fly.

- Smart S-Mods Handling: Re-applies your Story Mods. If you lack Story Points in your current playthrough, it dynamically downgrades them to standard hullmods instead of locking the process.

- Encyclopedic Error Log: Missing a gun or a fighter wing? The terminal scans Starsector database to print an orange breakdown displaying the missing item Name, Size, Base Cost, and Manufacturer.

- Built-in Safeguards and Management: A yellow warning screen protects you from accidentally overwriting an active slot. You can also physically delete blueprint text files directly from the UI.

- Multiplayer Build Sharing: Blueprints are saved in the common saves folder. Share them via Discord or forums, allowing other players to instantly drop your loadouts into their own fleets!

---

What's New in v1.1.0 (The Selective Update)

Live Template Preview Monitor: Opening the custom setup menu triggers a diagnostic scan that lists exact weapon and hullmod names, including whether they originate from base game files  It also checks for Gunnery tuning tags. Selective Paste Configuration Code: Modular switchesallow players to choose exactly what components to update (Weapons, Standard Hullmods and Flux, S-Mods, Gunnery Options, Fighter Wings, or Weapon Groups). Smart Chassis Verification: Fighter Wing switches automatically hide themselves if the ship chassis does not possess physical fighter bays, preventing display clutter. Progressive S-Mods Native Compatibility: The plugin automatically detects the presence of the Progressive S-Mods (PSM) mod. If active, it disables automated Story Point burning to protect ship experience mechanics, converting saved S-mods into standard Hullmods securely. Dynamic Slot Maintenance: Includes a dedicated "Delete blueprint" option to permanently wipe file configurations from your common cache.

What's New in v1.1.1 (Correctif)

A proper sorting-out of the mod that had set up in the bar and attempted to barricade various station access points. Added a key press to access the Terminal => "x".

How to Use the Terminal

1. Dock at any station or planetary market.

2. Click the option:

"Access ExchangeRefit Terminal (Manage Blueprints)"

.

3. Select your hull, pick one of the 5 archive slots, and manage your loadouts cleanly!

How to Share Loadouts Between Players

To Export/Send a build:

1. Save your ship layout in-game on any Slot (like Slot 1).

2. Go to your main Starsector directory, then open the folder: saves / common

3. Locate the file named: ExchangeRefit_HullId_Slot1.txt

4. Send this file to your friend (via Discord, Email, etc.).

To Import/Receive a build:

1. Download your friend text file and place it inside your own saves / common directory.

2. (Optional) You can rename Slot1 in the filename to Slot3 if you want to place it in your 3rd slot!

3. Open the game, access the ExchangeRefit terminal at any station, select the matching ship hull, and click Paste!

Author Note

As this is my very first mod and my coding knowledge is currently quite limited, I might not have caught every single quirk. However, I am fully committed to improving and maintaining ExchangeRefit! I will be deeply attentive to all feedback, bug reports, feature suggestions, and even critiques, as long as they remain constructive. Let us make this tool better together!

Installation

1. Download the zip file.

2. Extract the ExchangeRefit folder into your Starsector / mods / directory.

3. Enable ExchangeRefit in the Starsector launcher.

4. Enjoy your smooth refitting sessions!

DOWNLOAD LINK :

https://www.mediafire.com/file/it90pbaax7vn2zf/Exchangerefit+1.1.1.zip/file

ChangeLog v1.0.0: Initial Release. Built entirely on a localized dialogue tree with dynamic hull cloning to prevent stock variant locks, and integrated with AGC data tags.
